title: Which Taylor Swift Era Matches Your Personality?
description: Discover which Taylor Swift era matches your personality based on MBTI traits!

questions.text: At a party, you prefer to...

options.text: Meet new people and be the center of attention
Stick with close friends and have deep talks
Help the host and make sure everyone is okay
Observe quietly and analyze the room

questions.text: When making decisions, you rely on...

options.text: Planning every detail and sticking to the schedule
Going with the flow and spontaneous adventures
Socializing with a big group of friends
Figure it out as you go

questions.text: When working on a project, you...

options.text: Collaborate and bounce ideas off others
Start immediately and figure out details later

questions.text: When giving advice, you focus on...

options.text: Take the lead and introduce yourself
Wait for them to approach you

results.title: Lover
results.description: You're like Taylor's most romantic ballads - deep, thoughtful, and incredibly passionate. You value meaningful connections and often put others' needs before your own.

results.title: The Archer
results.description: You're strategic and independent like 'The Archer'. You know what you want and aren't afraid to go after it.

results.title: All Too Well
results.description: You're deeply emotional and romantic, like the epic 'All Too Well'. You feel things deeply and value authenticity.

results.title: Anti-Hero
results.description: You're the introspective 'Anti-Hero' - analytical, thoughtful, and sometimes feel like an outsider looking in.

results.title: Bejeweled
results.description: You're the life of the party 'Bejeweled' - charismatic, supportive, and love making everyone feel included.

results.title: Look What You Made Me Do
results.description: You're powerful and determined like 'Look What You Made Me Do'. You know your worth and aren't afraid to stand up for yourself.

results.title: Shake It Off
results.description: You're energetic and optimistic like 'Shake It Off' - you don't let anything bring you down and inspire others with your energy.

results.title: Question...?
results.description: You're curious and unpredictable like 'Question...' - always questioning, debating, and loving intellectual banter.

results.title: Enchanted
results.description: You're warm and devoted like 'Enchanted' - you value loyalty and create magical moments for those you love.

results.title: Tim McGraw
results.description: You're traditional and loyal like Taylor's country roots. You value reliability and remember the important details.

results.title: You Need To Calm Down
results.description: You're the supportive friend who wants everyone to get along, like 'You Need To Calm Down'. You thrive on harmony.

results.title: Ready For It?
results.description: You're confident and commanding like 'Ready For It?' - you take charge and get things done efficiently.

results.title: Cornelia Street
results.description: You're artistic and sensitive like 'Cornelia Street' - you experience life deeply and value your personal space.

results.title: Blank Space
results.description: You're the mysterious 'Blank Space' - cool on the surface but with a wild side only close friends see.
You're fun-loving and spontaneous like '22' - you live in the moment and bring energy everywhere you go.

results.title: I Knew You Were Trouble
results.description: You're bold and daring like 'I Knew You Were Trouble' - you love excitement and aren't afraid to take risks.
